card.statement: Reduced imaginary Verma modules belongs to $\mc{O}_{red,im}$. Indeed, for $\tilde{M}(\lambda)$ consider $T(\tilde{M}(\lambda)) = \C v_{\lambda}$ and $TF(V) = \bigoplus_{k\in\Z, n_1, \ldots, n_N\in\Z_{\geq0}} \tilde{M}(\lambda)_{\lambda+k\delta - n_1\alpha_1 - \ldots -n_N\alpha_N}$, and at least one $n_j\neq 0$. Moreover, direct sums of reduced imaginary Verma modules belongs to $\mc{O}_{red,im}$.
card.label: Example 4

paper.title: The category of reduced imaginary Verma modules
paper.abstract: For an arbitrary affine Lie algebra we study an analog of the category O for the natural Borel subalgebra and zero central charge. We show that such category is semisimple having the reduced imaginary Verma modules as its simple objects. This generalizes the result of Cox, Futorny, Misra in the case of affine sl(2).
